run_ltr_to_wrd: run the ltr_to_wrd script to convert letter-separated text with pipe delimiters into word-separated text via stdin
run_ltr_to_wrd_piped: run the ltr_to_wrd script by piping letter-level labels through it to produce word-level labels
review_main: review the main function that reads stdin line by line and transforms spaceless pipe-delimited text into spaced words
summarize_ltr_to_wrd: summarize the ltr_to_wrd script which removes spaces then replaces pipe characters with spaces for wav2vec label conversion
test_ltr_to_wrd: test the ltr_to_wrd script by piping letter-level labels and verifying word-level output
